pages.title: Finding Atlarus
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 22 to 48. Veins target up to 5 blocks, with 3 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 6.

pages.title: Working Atlarus
pages.text: Smelt Atlarus Ore or Atlarus Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 1750 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 11.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 5.0.$(br)Enchantability: 22.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 4, leggings 4, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.3.$(br)Enchantability: 2.

pages.title: Armor: Whirlwind
pages.text: A whirlwind barrier will deviate any projectile going towards you from a certain distance.

pages.title: Weapon: Gust of Wind
pages.text: A strong gust of wind pushes enemies away from you and breaks leaves and vines in a range of 5 blocks around you

pages.title: Hoe: Wind Scythe
pages.text: Wind helps you remove bushes and crops around you
